title: fix(packages): verify the checksum of the newest file with the same name
description:
## Description

`glab packages download` verifies the file it downloads against the SHA256 stored in the registry, and `fetchChecksum` took the first file in the package whose name matched ([download.go#L308-312](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/blob/b3bf6ccba7d855c656fb6bd4e1d8feb62fe8285f/internal/commands/packages/download/download.go#L308-312)). The package files API lists files by ID ascending unless asked otherwise ([package_files.rb#L45-63](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/6f4a1dae5b6a68cc38e2430397d2c44fe92ca1d5/lib/api/package_files.rb#L45-63)), so that was the oldest upload with that name. The generic download route serves the newest one: it resolves the file with `Packages::PackageFileFinder#execute!` ([generic_packages.rb#L168-169](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/6f4a1dae5b6a68cc38e2430397d2c44fe92ca1d5/lib/api/generic_packages.rb#L168-169)), which r
